structure.unit: Foreign Savings Institutions; Acquisitions by Out-Of-State Savings Institutions or Out-Of-State Savings Institution Holding Companies

law.catch_line: Acquisitions of state savings bank or holding companies by out-of-state financial institutions
law.text: A state savings bank, or holding company thereof, may not be acquired by a financial institution, or financial institution holding company, whose principal place of business is outside the Commonwealth, except in accordance with the provisions of this article.
